capabilities: Create meeting notes via a modal with title, date, attendees, type, and agenda
Structure notes with frontmatter and Agenda/Notes/Decisions/Action Items sections
Write action items as checkboxes with @owner syntax
Extract unchecked action items to a master Actions note
Browse recent meetings in a sidebar with attendee and action counts
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README lists features but includes no usage examples.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create structured meeting notes or track action items across separate meetings.
summary: Meeting notes system that creates structured meeting notes with attendees, agenda, decisions, and action items, and extracts actions to a master note.
